skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and apply the principles and methodologies of Environmental Impact Assessment (EIA) and Strategic Environmental Assessment (SEA) in project and policy development.
Comprehend the fundamental concepts and theories of environmental science, including the impact of development on the environment.
Manage and coordinate the implementation of EIA and SEA processes, including data collection, analysis, and reporting.
Analyze and evaluate environmental impacts of projects and policies, and develop strategies to mitigate negative effects.
Produce clear, structured, and evidence-based reports on environmental impact assessments.
Work effectively in teams to develop and present environmental impact assessments.
Effectively communicate findings and recommendations from environmental impact assessments to stakeholders.
Conduct independent research and gather data for environmental impact assessments.
Identify and solve environmental issues through the application of EIA and SEA methodologies.
Incorporate EIA and SEA results into decision-making processes for sustainable development.
